computer.text: Kwamfuta a cikin keɓaɓɓen wuri a wannan shafin: tana aron na'urar sarrafawa da ƙwaƙwalwar wannan na'ura, kuma ba ta taɓa kaiwa ga wani abu dabam a kanta. /workspace yana ɗauke da fayilolinka, ko wurin aikin wannan aiki.
computer.engine.shell.text: bash da kayan aikinsa: grep, sed, awk, jq, curl…
computer.engine.quickjs.text: Lissafi daidai, tare da fakitoci daga npm
computer.engine.pyodide.text: Aikin bayanai, tare da pandas, NumPy da Matplotlib: kusan {size} a karon farko
computer.internet.text: Abin da kwamfutar za ta iya isa gare shi. Ba ta taɓa samun kukis ko makullanka ba.
computer.sites: Shafukan da za ta iya isa gare su koyaushe
computer.registries.text: Don madubi, kamar na ƙungiyarka. Makulli yana zama a wannan na'urar kuma yana zuwa adireshinsa kawai.
computer.workspace.text: Fayilolin da kwamfutar ke aiki a kai idan ɗawainiya ba ta da fayil ɗin ajiya.
computer.workspace.confirm: A goge duk fayilolin da ke wurin aikin wannan aiki?
computer.reach.question: A bar kwamfutar ta isa ga {site}?
computer.relay: Isa ga yanar gizo ta hanyar
computer.relay.text: Adireshin mai isarwa, don shafukan da ke ƙin buƙatu daga wasu shafuka. Babu komai: kai tsaye, ta hanyar proxy na wannan na'urar.
computer.terminal.text: Kai da kanka ka gudanar da umarni a kwamfutar, a kan fayilolin da tattaunawar ke amfani da su; saƙonka na gaba zai faɗi abin da ka gudanar. {keys} yana buɗe ta daga ko'ina.
computer.terminal.refused: Ba a ajiye ba, domin an canza shi a wani wuri a halin da ake ciki: {files}
